spellbook.finance/limitations: This changes nothing and sends nothing to TCGplayer. It is the safe half of the pair.
It is paginated. Read the cursor it returns and page until there is none left before telling a person a total.
A price here is a suggestion from the stated multiplier and floor, capped at two TCGplayer dead zones. It is not a price TCGplayer has accepted.
TCGplayer has no publish API for a seller. Nothing in SpellBook can put these cards on TCGplayer without a person uploading a file or running the browser extension.

description: Show which cards in one workspace would be listed on TCGplayer, and at what price, without changing anything. TCGplayer has no server-side publish, so the real path is a CSV a person uploads to the TCGplayer portal. Call this first and show the person the candidates and the totals, then call spellbook_tcg_listing_export only once they have agreed to upload the file.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page, passed back unchanged. Omit to start from the first page.

floorPrice.description: A price floor in USD for this preview. Omit to use the workspace's stored floor.

marketMultiplier.description: Price multiplier applied to market price for this preview. Omit to use the workspace's stored pricing.

sampleSize.description: Maximum candidate rows to preview. Omit for the default sample size.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to preview a TCGplayer listing run for. Required.

name: spellbook_tcg_listing_preview
